summary: The HKEX CNH Gold Futures Excess Return Index tracks the excess return performance of CNH (offshore Chinese Yuan) denominated gold futures contracts traded on the Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX). name: HKEX CNH Gold Futures Spot Pric
summary: The HKEX CNH Gold Futures Spot Price Index tracks the spot price of CNH (offshore Chinese Yuan) denominated gold futures contracts traded on the Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX). name: HKEX CNH Gold Futures Total Ret
summary: The HKEX CNH Gold Futures Total Return Index tracks the total return performance of CNH (offshore Chinese Yuan) denominated gold futures contracts traded on the Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX). It includes both the price appreciation and any roll yield from maintaining exposure to the futures contracts. The index is designed for investors seeking the full return potential of CNH-denominated gold futures.

name: HKEX USD Gold Futures Excess Re
summary: The HKEX USD Gold Futures Excess Return Index is designed to reflect the performance of a fully collateralized position in the USD-denominated Gold Futures contract traded on the Hong Kong Exchange, less the return on the collateral. The index represents the return from holding a portfolio of front-month Gold Futures contracts and rolling the position forward each month. It captures the excess return over the collateral yield.

name: HKEX USD Gold Futures Spot Pric
summary: The HKEX USD Gold Futures Spot Price Index tracks the spot price of USD-denominated Gold Futures contracts traded on the Hong Kong Exchange. It reflects the fluctuations in the price of gold futures without considering the effects of rolling futures contracts or collateral yield. The index provides a benchmark for the current market value of gold futures contracts.

name: HKEX USD Gold Futures Total Ret
summary: The HKEX USD Gold Futures Total Return Index tracks the performance of a fully collateralized investment in USD-denominated Gold Futures contracts traded on the Hong Kong Exchange, including the return on the collateral. The index represents the total return from investing in front-month Gold Futures contracts and rolling the position forward each month, along with the interest earned on the collateral. It captures the combined effect of price changes and collateral yield.
